title: Intrathoracic Vagotomy and Cough Induction Protocol
author: Donald Bolser
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgm5ju86

steps.title: Anesthetize Animal
steps.instruction: Induce anesthesia and transition to maintenance dosing.

substeps.instruction: Wean onto sodium pentobarbital anesthesia (28 mg/kg, iv).

steps.title: Insert Catheters and Cannulate Trachea
steps.instruction: Establish vascular access and airway management.

substeps.instruction: Place femoral venous and arterial catheters.
Record arterial blood pressure and end tidal CO2.

steps.title: Place EMG Electrodes
steps.instruction: Insert bipolar fine insulated wires several mm apart into specific upper airway and chest wall muscles.

substeps.instruction: Place electrodes in the parasternal, diaphragm, and transversus abdominis muscles.
Place electrodes in the thyroarytenoid, cricopharyngeus, thyropharyngeus, thyrohyoid, genioglossus, mylohyoid, and geniohyoid muscles.

steps.title: Establish Ventilation and Surgical Access
steps.instruction: Prepare the animal for thoracic surgery.

substeps.instruction: Place animals on a mechanical ventilator.
Make bilateral incisions into the chestwall at T4.

steps.title: Perform Baseline Cough Induction
steps.instruction: Induce cough using mechanical and chemical stimulation prior to vagotomy.

substeps.instruction: Perform mechanical stimulation by introducing a small flexible cannula into the airway via a small hole in the tracheal tube and rotating it at approximately 2 Hz for 10 sec trials.
Perform chemical stimulation by injecting capsaicin (0.5 cc, 10 micromolar) into the intrathoracic trachea via the small hole in the tracheal tube.
Section the intrathoracic vagus bilaterally caudal to the branch of the recurrent laryngeal nerves.

steps.title: Perform Post-Vagotomy Cough Induction
steps.instruction: Repeat cough stimulation trials and vary respiratory pressure.

substeps.instruction: Perform mechanical cough trials immediately after thoracotomy but before vagotomy.
Perform both mechanical and chemical cough stimulation trials after intrathoracic vagotomy.
Vary positive end expiratory pressure in steps from 0-5cm H2O and perform mechanically-induced cough trials.
